facts.fact: The civil identification directorate (DNIC) states in March 2023 that Law 6/2022 accepts, for an identity card application, a birth certificate generated in the electronic civil registration system, and that reusing eSIRCEV birth registration data for card issuance was still a challenge to be made operational; deaths are not mentioned.

systems.country_label: eSIRCEV; sistema electrónico de registo civil
systems.tiers: Not stated; holds birth registration data and generates birth certificates

systems.country_label: Sistema de Identificação Civil (SICEBI); Sistema Electrónico de Identificação Civil
systems.owner: Direcção Nacional de Identificação Civil, Ministério do Interior
systems.tiers: 208 service posts in all provinces and districts and some administrative posts and localities, 14 diplomatic and consular missions, mobile brigades, and a national production centre in Maputo; data network linking all posts

systems.country_label: interoperabilidade entre o SICEBI e o eSIRCEV
systems.tiers: Not operational in March 2023; listed as a challenge
